note: Arrangements of 17 straight lines forming 85 Kobon triangles (Tamura's bound, hence optimal), each obtained by removing one line from an 18-line, 93-triangle arrangement of k18_final. Lines are exact rationals (a, b, c) meaning a*x + b*y = c, copied verbatim from the source; lines_float is for plotting only. Arrangements with equal canonical_sha256 are isomorphic (relabeling of lines and reversal of individual lines).
source: k18_final (A. Maiorana, 2026): 2357 arrangements of 18 lines with 93 triangles
